askme.chat.title: Ask Me - AI Chat
askme.chat.hint: Ask anything, request a control (FOV 30), or type /help...
askme.chat.welcome: Ask Me ready. Controls, language selection, caching, and server command scanning are enabled.
askme.tip.chat_input: Enter a question or control instruction, or start with / for commands.
askme.tip.scan_now: Scan server commands and /help into cache.
askme.tip.autoreply: Toggle automatic reply when another player mentions your IGN.
askme.tip.api_key: Google Gemini API key. Only the first two characters show unless revealed.
askme.tip.language: Response language (type any language or click Cycle).
askme.tip.prompt: Extra system instructions sent with requests.
askme.tip.controls: Allow AI to adjust FOV, keybinds, disconnect, gamma, HUD, and camera.
askme.tip.savage: Toggle roast vs friendly tag reply tone.
askme.tip.public: Send tag replies to public chat or keep local.
askme.gui.title: Ask Me - Settings
askme.gui.subtitle: Google Gemini Control & Chat
askme.tip.style_button: Choose how your name looks in chat and which game sound plays when it appears.
askme.style.title: Ask Me - Name Highlight & Sound
askme.tip.style_on: Turn the name highlight on or off. It works in chat, kill and death messages.
askme.tip.style_color: Colour of your name as #RRGGBB, for example #FFD54F.
askme.tip.style_next_color: Switch to the next ready-made colour.
askme.tip.style_sound: Click to try the next game sound. Pick 'off' for no sound.
askme.tip.bg_button: Switch the settings background between the built-in picture and your own picture. Drop an image file on this screen, or use /askme background <file>.
askme.gui.bg_none: No custom picture yet. Drop an image file on this screen, or use /askme background <file>.
